cohort: Women who delivered between November 2016 and March 2017 in South 24 Parganas district, West Bengal, India.
finding: All women reported OOPE for delivery care, with a median OOPE of INR 865 at public hospitals and INR 1700 at home.
mod_finding: Caesarian section was associated with higher OOPE among public hospital deliveries (OR 56.8, 95% CI 13.6-237).
